items.title: Leutenegger/book-to-skill
items.why: It offers a practical productivity hack for converting your CS textbooks into searchable AI study assistants.
items.summary: An open-source utility that parses technical PDF textbooks and turns them into custom reference skills for the Claude Code coding assistant.

items.title: Qwen 3.8 27B
items.why: Qwen models are among the top open-source LLMs available today for local experimentation and developer projects.
items.summary: Alibaba released a new 27-billion parameter model in its popular Qwen open-weights language model series.

items.title: shadcn-ui/chatbot-template
items.why: It gives you a complete, practical starter kit if you want to build and deploy your own AI chat web app.
items.summary: A beginner-friendly web template for building custom AI chatbots using Next.js, modern UI components, and Vercel AI tools.

items.title: deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
items.why: DeepSeek is one of the most prominent open-weights AI creators, and this tool helps you learn how plugin architectures work in AI systems.
items.summary: An open-source framework from DeepSeek designed to let developers extend AI agent capabilities through modular plugins.

items.title: milind-soni/OpenMausBot
items.why: It serves as a neat open-source example of how developers build autonomous coding agents using secure code execution sandboxes.
items.summary: An open-source AI bot framework that provides language models with an isolated virtual machine to run code safely and execute tasks.

items.title: DrHazemAli/enterprise-system-design
items.why: System design is a critical topic for software engineering internships and career growth beyond basic programming projects.
items.summary: A reference course covering fundamental concepts for building reliable software systems that handle real web traffic and security needs.

items.title: AI Coding Without the Vibes
items.why: As a student learning to code alongside AI, developing proper testing and verification habits early is essential.
items.summary: A discussion on disciplined software habits when coding with AI assistants, focusing on test-driven verification instead of trusting generated code blindly.

items.title: Patterns and problems in emerging multi-agent systems
items.why: Multi-agent systems are a key emerging area in AI software development, and understanding these patterns will help you design better tools.
items.summary: An analysis of standard design patterns and common pitfalls developers encounter when connecting multiple AI agents together.

items.title: Stripe Clinches over $7B Deal to Buy AI Firm OpenRouter
items.why: OpenRouter is widely used by developer tools to access various LLMs, making this acquisition a notable milestone for the developer ecosystem.
items.summary: Financial platform Stripe has reportedly agreed to buy OpenRouter, a popular unified API service used by developers to query AI models.

items.title: AI isn’t outthinking mathematicians, it’s out-remembering them
items.why: It helps you build a realistic mental model of how LLMs actually work without getting lost in hype or overly technical jargon.
items.summary: An insightful article explaining how modern AI models solve complex math problems mainly through vast pattern retrieval rather than human-like logic.

items.title: Trump says US to scale back military drills with South Korea after it stayed out of Iran war
items.why: This marks a notable shift in US international relations and military alliances in East Asia.
items.summary: President Trump announced a reduction in joint US military exercises with South Korea after South Korea declined involvement in military actions in Iran.

items.title: Russia says at least seven killed in largest Ukrainian attack of 2026
items.why: It provides crucial coverage on significant escalations in the ongoing conflict between Ukraine and Russia.
items.summary: Ukraine launched a major drone strike across Russian regions, while Russian strikes simultaneously targeted Kyiv, marking a major surge in fighting.
